authority: User-approved shared CivicAscent AI operating direction
core_rules: Complete every safe authorized step before asking for user help; do not stop at plans, status updates, or repeated copy/paste instructions.
Never claim any agent executed, remained online, migrated, completed a purchase or contacted anyone without verifiable system evidence.
Preserve all earlier approved page checkpoints; work on isolated branches and keep production unchanged until independent QC and explicit final release.
Safari Learning World is the only active site design. Six original backgrounds, one consistent cinematic African safari world; no disconnected mockups, dashboards, pills or fake interfaces.
Use live semantic HTML controls, not text/buttons painted into background art. Avoid all externally watermarked, unclear-rights or unapproved image/video assets in production.
Frame 5 Living AI Lab is design/build priority, followed by Scene 1 Home, then 2/3/4/6.
Run multi-device, keyboard, reduced-motion, contrast, privacy, disclaimers, link, error-path and payment-scope QC as relevant.
Zero-dollar ceiling; no additional metered Replit, generation or paid AI provider calls without specific cost approval.
All material changes get a savepoint, source/evidence links, honest status and reversible rollback plan.
Independent critical evaluation and QC cannot be self-approved by the implementation agent; final user visual approval and production release remain separate.
ack_policy: Agents/automations must read this file before task planning and cite law.version in dispatch/evidence. Static files do not prove connected agents loaded this law.
secrets: Never record API keys in LAW, issues, reports or public repository.
